sources.note: Owner research in issue #379 (pattern 3): a higher extra contribution allows leaving until the end of the month in which it first applies; since 2026-07-30 insurers no longer have to tell members individually. No page was fetched for this file.

route: A higher extra contribution lets you leave until the end of the month in which it first applies. Apply to the new insurer, which handles the change with the old one.
person_does: Choose the new insurer and check its extra contribution on its own site.
Sign the application and send it before the deadline.
Send your assistant the new insurer's confirmation.
